projects.name: MACE: Customer Interviews (June - July 2026)
projects.description: The objective of this interview is to understand how external customers currently request TÜV SÜD services, what information they need, where they face challenges, and what they expect from a future digital experience within the MACE Application.
hiddenNotes: Customers need bulk product data entry, reuse across certificates, and portfolio visibility
Missing affected departments or assessments cause change resubmission
hiddenQuestions: Validate whether application forms should capture planned submission evidence and previously reviewed evidence references.
Validate whether product and quality-management-system change routing requires clearer service guidance.

Validate whether supplier direct upload can satisfy regulatory evidence ownership while protecting supplier-sensitive content, limiting supplier visibility, and allowing the manufacturer to track completion.
Validate whether read-only customer access to master certification data reduces edit risk without slowing change submissions.
